test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 9 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the highlighted word.**

The **__hapless__** incident was a result of sheer negligence by the authorities.
solution:
The correct answer is, '**Ill-fated'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ill-fated** means **unfortunate or unlucky.**

 
 
• Example, ***a family had an ill-fated trip to the zoo where they lost their son***.
 
 
 
• **Hapless** means **cursed or unlucky**.
 
 
• Example, ***a child's life becomes a roller-coaster when his parents go through a hapless divorce.***
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Triumphant** means **victory or success.**
 
• **Joyful** means **happy and blissful.**
 
• **Grateful** means **thankful.**
